description: ADO-BOOK with runtime bookmark values passed back (static bookmarks are the row position, VT_R8, from the earlier records): on a client static batch-optimistic recordset of K, Bookmark put to R8 3 (the ID read back), a Clone given R8 3 (its ID), CompareBookmarks(R8 1, R8 3) and (R8 3, R8 3), a bookmark from a second independent recordset of the same text; then pending Delete of row 2 and UpdateBatch, R8 3 put again (does the bookmark follow the row or the position), and Requery then R8 3; the same sequence on a server static read-only recordset. Asks the bookmark identity across clone, independent recordset, delete and Requery.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
